objective_for_doctor:
Age: 16
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have lower chest pain, left side of the chest pain, and upper chest pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi. I’ve had pain in my lower chest and also the left and upper part of my chest—like a knife-stab feeling. I also get out of breath with very little effort, and I feel worse when I lie flat (I need to sit up), and it happens with exertion too.
[ASK] Does the patient have **chest pain that is worse with breathing in (pleuritic) or coughing**?
I’m not sure about coughing making it worse. I do feel it more when I breathe in, like it’s sharper with breathing.
[ASK] Do you have **sudden shortness of breath with low oxygen / respiratory distress**?
No, it didn’t start suddenly. But I do feel really short of breath even with minimal physical effort, and it gets pretty bad.
[ASK] Do you have chest pain that is worse when you take a deep breath or lie flat (and/or improves when you sit up)?
Yes—it's worse when I take a deep breath, and it also gets worse when I lie flat. It feels a bit better if I sit up.
